capability.title: Design durable data and evidence pipelines
capability.summary: I preserve evidence with stable identities, retained material, and provenance so it remains usable from the original work record through a reviewed public page.

blocks.body:
## Keep evidence useful after its source session ends

A screenshot, source sample, or terminal recording needs both retained material and enough context to explain what it represents. I built the Work Evidence Pipeline and Work Report System around those requirements.

Artifacts keep a stable identity, semantic kind, source locator, review state, and content facts. Reports organize the explanation and selected evidence, while Portfolio Editor can reuse that material in a public page.

## Retain the material when it becomes evidence

I introduced copying at attachment time so reports could retain images, documents, code, terminal output, and structured data independently of temporary source paths. The maintained store keeps local files in an owned corpus and distinguishes them from external references or known-missing material.

Files are staged and moved atomically before the metadata transaction commits. Detaching evidence removes an association while preserving the underlying material, keeping editorial selection separate from storage ownership.

## Strengthen provenance without discarding history

A provenance migration required each artifact to identify its producing operation, source path, and provenance-rule version. Older evidence was retained through explicit import records: 711 artifacts were linked through 100 backfill operations, with no unresolved rows left by that migration.

The same milestone added a save boundary in Portfolio Editor that stops unresolved image references from entering a saved page. A responsive temporary preview could remain available while durable storage was checked before saving.

## Carry meaning into reuse and recovery

Portfolio Editor inspects artifact content before choosing a representation such as a gallery, comparison, chart, or code block. The public page receives selected owned material while the source report retains its private context.

Work Report System supports backups and portable exports that retain identities and ordered associations, with validation of relationships, files, and optional content digests. Portfolio Site builds a verified public artifact from accepted content. These boundaries make the retained evidence useful for recovery as well as presentation.
